name: A Journey Begins
description: Professor Linden has asked you to help complete the Pokédex.
steps: Meet Professor Linden in the lab.
Head north along Route 1.

name: Shards of Light
description: Team Eclipse is stealing light shards from Tessera's shrines. Find out why.
steps: Investigate the shrine in Whisperwood.
Earn the Sprout Badge in Brindle City.
Pass through Cobblecrest Cave to Port Tidewater.
Stop Team Eclipse at the Port Tidewater docks.
Earn the Tide Badge from Marina.

name: The Lost Poké Doll
description: A girl in Fernwick Town lost her Poké Doll in Whisperwood.
steps: Find the Poké Doll in Whisperwood.
Return it to the girl in Fernwick Town.

name: Mushroom Survey
description: A researcher in Brindle City wants data on mushroom Pokémon from Whisperwood.
steps: Catch a Shroomish, a Paras and a Morelull.
Report back to the researcher in Brindle City.

name: Pen Pal Pokémon
description: A sailor's kid in Port Tidewater wants to swap Pokémon stories.
steps: Show the kid a Wooper from Route 4.
Receive the kid's Pokémon in exchange.

name: Lost in Cobblecrest
description: A hiker's partner is lost somewhere in Cobblecrest Cave.
steps: Find the lost hiker in the cave's lower floor.
Tell the hiker on Route 4 the good news.

name: Shadows over Tessera
description: Team Eclipse is stealing light across Tessera. Follow the trail from Lumen Village to Seraphine Town.
steps: Head south to Lumen Village.
Find out why Voltara City is blacked out.
Earn the Spark Badge from Volta.
Visit Dr. Mira's lab in Voltara City.
Earn the Stone Badge from Garnet in Quarrytown.
Meet Warden Talo at the Ruins of Sol.
Cross Mt. Prism and stop Team Eclipse.
Earn the Mist Badge from Elowen in Seraphine Town.

name: The Traveler's Gift
description: Elder Ione of Lumen Village keeps Pokémon left by a traveler from Kanto.
steps: See the mural deep in the Lumen Ruins.
Tell Elder Ione about the mural.
Return to Elder Ione with a Key Stone.

name: Psychic Survey
description: A researcher in Lumen Village wants proof that Psychic Pokémon gather in the ruins.
steps: Catch Unown, Natu, Baltoy and Sigilyph, then report back.

name: Live Wire
description: A Voltara lineman dropped his toolbox somewhere on Route 7.
steps: Find the lineman's toolbox on Route 7.
Return the toolbox to the lineman in Voltara City.

name: Dig Site Duty
description: Quarrytown's foreman lost his lucky pickaxe on Route 8.
steps: Find the foreman's pickaxe on Route 8.
Return the pickaxe to the foreman.
Bring a fossil to the Quarrytown Fossil Lab.

name: Sun and Moon
description: An acolyte at the Ruins of Sol wants to see the sun and the moon side by side.
steps: Catch Solrock and Lunatone, then visit the acolyte.

name: Song of the Mist
description: A bard in Seraphine Town is writing a ballad about cotton-winged birds.
steps: Show the bard a Swablu.

name: Embers and Frost
description: Team Eclipse is hunting for light west of Seraphine. Earn the Ember and Frost Badges.
steps: Travel west along Route 9 and defeat Blaise at the Ashfall Gym.
Find Quartz in Crystal Cavern, south of Ashfall.
Cross the bay on Route 11 and meet Hollis in Frostmere Town.
Defeat Isolde at the Frostmere Gym.
Climb Route 12 to Dragonspire City.

name: Lapras's Song
description: A homesick Lapras at the Sea Cottage on Route 11 loves pearls.
steps: Find a Big Pearl on the islet in the middle of Route 11.
Bring the Big Pearl to the Sea Cottage.

name: Lost on the Ice
description: Pip from Frostmere went to watch the Snom on Route 12's frozen slope.
steps: Find Pip on the frozen slope of Route 12.
Tell Pip's grandmother in Frostmere that he's safe.

name: Hot Spring Mail
description: A gentleman at the Ashfall hot spring inn wants a letter delivered to his daughter.
steps: Deliver the letter to the scientist at Hollis's Lodge in Frostmere.

name: Crystal Companion
description: Quartz's aide wants to see a Carbink, the jewel Pokémon of Crystal Cavern.
steps: Catch a Carbink and show it to Quartz's aide.

name: Twilight over Tessera
description: Team Eclipse is making its final move on Mt. Prism. Earn the last Badge, stop Umbra and reach the League.
steps: Earn the Dusk Badge from Ryuga in Dragonspire City.
Cross Umbral Pass and climb Prism Summit.
Stop Boss Umbra at the summit altar.
Travel Route 13 and Victory Road to Prism Plateau.
Defeat the Elite Four and Champion Celeste.

name: The Dragon Trial
description: Elder Draca of the Dragon Shrine tests visitors' knowledge of dragons.
steps: Answer Elder Draca's three questions at the Dragon Shrine.

name: Scales for a Collector
description: A collector in Dragonspire City wants three Dragon Scales for her display case.
steps: Bring three Dragon Scales to the collector in Dragonspire City.

name: Skyfall Swap
description: A retired sailor in Dragonspire City wants a Seaking from Scalemirror Pond.
steps: Trade a Seaking to the sailor in Dragonspire City.

name: Champion of the Isles
description: The Coral Isles welcome Tessera's new Champion. Old rivals and older legends are waiting.
steps: Explore the Coral Isles and find the Champions' Hall in Coral Town.
Win rematches against all eight Gym Leaders in the Champions' Hall.
Defeat the Elite Four and Champion Celeste in the Rematch Chamber.
Enter the Silent Grotto on Route 17 and face what waits in its depths.

name: Six Guardians
description: An old man in Coral Town dreams of seeing the six guardians of the isles.
steps: Catch Solgaleo, Lunala, Lugia, Kyogre, Groudon and Rayquaza, then visit the old man.

name: Wings of the Storm
description: Tempest Isle's storm sage says three legendary birds serve the guardian of the seas.
steps: Face Articuno (Route 17), Zapdos (Tower Isle) and Moltres (Cinder Isle), then see the storm sage.
Use the Silver Wing to reach Lugia at the bottom of Tempest Cave.

name: Sea, Land and Sky
description: The titans of sea and land sleep in the Coral Isles. Only the sky serpent can calm them.
steps: Face Kyogre in the Seafloor Cavern (Route 16) and Groudon in the Magma Vent (Cinder Isle).
Climb the Sky Pillar on Pillar Isle and face Rayquaza.

name: Light of the Eclipse
description: The warden of Eclipse Atoll guards an ancient secret of sun, moon and the Prism Pokémon.
steps: Catch Solgaleo or Lunala at the atoll's altars.
Return to the atoll warden.

name: Tower Climber
description: The Battle Tower on Tower Isle tests a team across seven battles in a row.
steps: Clear all seven rounds of a Battle Tower challenge.
Reach a 20-win streak and defeat the Tower Tycoon.

name: Beachcomber
description: A boy in Coral Town collects treasures from the beach.
steps: Find three Big Pearls hidden around the isles and bring them to him.

name: Island Sun
description: A researcher in Coral Town wants a mainland Exeggutor to compare with his Alolan one.
steps: Bring an Exeggutor to the researcher in the Islander's House.

name: Power Spot Survey
description: The den assistant on Route 14 runs raid battles against Gigantamax Pokémon.
steps: Clear five raid battles in the Power Spot Den.

name: The Odd Tree
description: A Brindle City florist lost her Squirt Bottle in Mossgrove Thicket.
steps: Find the Squirt Bottle in Mossgrove Thicket and bring it to the Brindle flower shop.
Water the odd tree on the Brookside Trail, east of Hollowbrook.

name: The Fishing Log
description: Angler Ross on the Brookside Trail wants to see a beginner's fishing log.
steps: Catch a Magikarp, a Poliwag and a Goldeen, then visit Angler Ross.

name: Birds of a Feather
description: A trader in Fernwick's Pokémon Center will swap his Rookidee for a Pidgey.
steps: Bring a Pidgey to the trader in Fernwick Town's Pokémon Center.

name: The Dark Lighthouse
description: A Wingull stole the Tidewater Lighthouse keeper's lamp-room key.
steps: Find the keeper's key in the sea cave below Tidewater Cape and bring it to him.
Climb to the lamp room and help the keeper light the lamp.

name: Mushroom Fertilizer
description: The Sunberry Orchard keeper needs a Big Mushroom for his tired trees.
steps: Bring a Big Mushroom to the orchard keeper north of Route 3.

name: Deckhand Wanted
description: A sailor in Port Tidewater wants a Machop and offers his Clobbopus, Inky.
steps: Bring a Machop to the sailor in Port Tidewater.

name: Power to the Ridge
description: Engineer Watts of Ridge Station dropped a Machine Part in Glimmer Cave.
steps: Find the Machine Part in dark Glimmer Cave, north of Route 6, and return it to Ridge Station.

name: Run, Zappy, Run
description: A trainer in Voltara's Pokémon Center wants an Electrike for her Blitzle, Zappy.
steps: Bring an Electrike to the trader in Voltara City's Pokémon Center.

name: Treasure of the Tide
description: A shell collector in Seabreeze Cove has always wanted a Big Pearl.
steps: Bring a Big Pearl to the collector's hut in Seabreeze Cove, east of Route 5.

name: Tam's Lamp
description: Old Bryn of Quarrytown left his late partner's lamp in the vault of the collapsed Shaft No. 3.
steps: Find Tam's lamp in the deepest gallery of the Old Shaft.
Bring the lamp back to Bryn in Quarrytown.

name: Tablets of Sol
description: A scholar at the Temple of Sol wants the four tablets of the Sol Catacombs read in full.
steps: Read the four tablets in the Sol Catacombs and the Sun Sanctum.
Report to the scholar in the Temple of Sol.

name: Strata Survey
description: Dr. Fenna is recording which Pokémon live in each rock layer around Quarrytown.
steps: Catch a Klawf, a Silicobra and a Timburr, then visit Dr. Fenna in Strata Gulch.

name: The Silent Crystals
description: A hermit in the Prism Grotto wants the three prism shards scattered around its crystal lake.
steps: Find the three prism shards in the Prism Grotto.
Bring the shards to the hermit on the central island.

name: Stolen Light
description: Surveyor Maeve found Team Eclipse siphoning the crystal heart beneath Mt. Prism 2F.
steps: Stop the Eclipse scientist at the far end of the dig site.
Tell Maeve the siphon has stopped.

name: Lost in the Mist
description: Mrs. Rowan's daughter Poppy chased a Clefairy into Mistwood, north of Seraphine Town.
steps: Find Poppy in Mistwood.
Let Mrs. Rowan in Seraphine Town know that Poppy is safe.

name: Burned and Stranded
description: A hiker was burned by a Slugma deep in Cinder Hollow and can't climb out.
steps: Bring the hiker in Cinder Hollow B1F a Burn Heal.

name: Trial by Fire
description: Master Kaen, Blaise's old teacher, battles only trainers who beat his three students.
steps: Defeat Brand, Blaze and Coal on the Ashen Trail, then Master Kaen in the Obsidian Grotto.

name: The Glassblower's Furnace
description: Vitra the glassblower in Ashfall City needs a Heat Rock to even out her furnace.
steps: Bring a Heat Rock to Vitra's glass workshop in Ashfall City.

name: The Breathing Ice
description: Brynn, Hollis's assistant, needs Power Spot readings from the three glowing vents in Rime Hollow.
steps: Find the three glowing vents in Rime Hollow, north of Frostmere.
Two more vents to go.
One more vent to go.
Report the readings to Brynn at Hollis's Lodge.

name: The Halcyon's Log
description: Captain Morrel of the Sea Cottage lost his logbook when the S.S. Halcyon ran aground in Tide Grotto.
steps: Find the captain's strongbox in the flooded hold of the S.S. Halcyon.
Bring the logbook to Captain Morrel at the Sea Cottage on Route 11.

name: Tuition in Scales
description: Margit, a retired move tutor in Frostmere, will teach your Pokémon for the old fee: one Heart Scale.
steps: Bring Margit a Heart Scale.

name: Crystal Thief
description: Someone has been stealing Tera Shards from Quartz's sample crates in Geode Hollow.
steps: Find the thief in Geode Hollow, below Crystal Cavern 1F.
Return the stolen shards to the porter at Quartz's camp.

name: Light Before the Dusk
description: Archivist Wen of Dragonspire wants rubbings of the three Prism Tablets, which tell what sleeps on Mt. Prism.
steps: Find the three Prism Tablets: Route 12's ridge, the Dragon's Roost and Scalemirror Pond.
Two tablets to go.
One tablet to go.
Bring the rubbings to Wen at the Clan Archive in Dragonspire.

name: The Hermit of the Roost
description: Hermit Sorin, Elder Draca's teacher, guards the Dragon Clan's secret technique on the Dragon's Roost.
steps: Pass Elder Draca's Dragon Trial, then defeat Hermit Sorin.

name: The Second Lens
description: Clan scout Haru suspects Team Eclipse is building a backup lens in a cave off Umbral Pass.
steps: Find and destroy the backup lens in the Eclipse Workshop.
Tell Haru in Umbral Pass.

name: Eclipse Remnants
description: Agent Calloway at the Highland Lodge is hunting the last Team Eclipse cells and the fragments of Umbra's lens.
steps: Find the three remnant cells: the Route 13 lake islet, under Victory Road, and past the Skyfall Grotto.
Two cells to go.
One cell to go.
Report to Agent Calloway at the Highland Lodge on Route 13.

name: The Linden Field Notes
description: Prof. Linden studies how people and Pokémon live together. He mails field notes, one volume per badge pair, and asks you to observe what he cannot.
steps: Vol. 1, Bond observation: show Linden's contact in Brindle City's Pokémon Center a bonded starter.
Vol. 2, Night sighting: photograph a Joltik at night with the trail camera on Route 7, then report to Mira's lab in Voltara City.
Vol. 3, Fossil lineage: revive a fossil in Quarrytown and show it to Linden's contact in Lumen Village.
Vol. 4, Mist behaviour: take Mistwood fog readings in the morning, by day and at night, then report to the Fairy Keeper in Seraphine Town.
Vol. 5, Thermal study: set three sensors around Ashfall by day, read them after dark and report to the Magma Elder's house.
Vol. 6, Cold-weather behaviour: log all three markers along Route 12 and report to the house in Frostmere Town.
Vol. 7, Final thesis: defend the thesis at the Collector's House in Dragonspire City.

name: Kai's Notebook
description: Your rival left torn pages of his notebook across Tessera. Each one points to the next town, and to what he was thinking when he wrote it.
steps: Entry 1: a page says Kai hid a cache on Route 3, behind a Cut tree in the far west corner.
Entry 2: win over the three judges of the Port Tidewater cooking contest (badge 2).
Entry 3: put the glitching terminals in the Voltara Mira Lab back in the right order (badge 3).
Entry 4: reset the three mine-cart rails in Quarrytown in the order the carts run (badge 4).
Entry 5: spar with Kai in Seraphine Town (badge 5).
Entry 6: find Kai in Frostmere Town and read his apology (badge 7).
Capstone: meet Kai in the Victory Road side room (badge 8).

name: The Umbra Files
description: A grunt who left Team Eclipse is hiding in Whisperwood. He wants the truth about Umbra's eclipse written down before it is forgotten.
steps: Document 1: read the defector's notes on the desk in his Whisperwood hideout.
Document 2: open the crate in the Harbor Warehouse in Port Tidewater (two switches).
Document 3: find the key-card in the Voltara Power Plant and open the safe.
Document 4: search the boulder room on Mt. Prism 2F (Strength).
Document 5: reach the heat vent in Ashfall Caldera with a fire-resistant Pokémon in your party.
Document 6: climb the frozen waterfall in Frozen Falls on Route 12 (Waterfall).
Document 7: search the Prism Summit peak, where Umbra made his stand.
Document 8: beat the three ex-admins guarding Umbra's letter in the Eclipse Lens Lab.
Epilogue: read Umbra's letter with the defector in Whisperwood.
File the eight documents with the archivist in the hideout.
